title: Test-line budget: new tests past a net line allowance need a recorded reason
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: operator asked to adopt the OpenClaw CI cost lessons (vincent.build/openclaw-ci-cost-reduction): deleting low-value tests cut 417,906 net test lines and a budget allows 400 net new test lines per change without an allocation record. KRN has no test-size budget; CI wall time is the delivery friction (first-push-green).

Outcome: a measured proposal: KRN test lines and per-shard time by area, the 20 slowest/least-failing test files, and a recommended net-line allowance with the check that would enforce it, recorded for the lead to accept or reject.
Proof: .krn/runs/research/test-budget.md exists with the table and the recommendation.
